description: A DATA S_PDU that asks for client delivery confirmation is delivered to the bound client and answered with a DATA DELIVERY CONFIRM S_PDU, sent back by ARQ.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as dts-arq/rx-data-acked: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED goes at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made as the Called node (B-0213), with cas.first_data and the SIS soft link timers. At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (type 9, FSN 0, EOT 20) carries a DATA C_PDU whose DATA S_PDU is priority 0, source SAP 5, destination SAP 9, CLIENT DELIVERY CONFIRM REQUIRED and VALID TTD set with day 0 and second 0 (byte 2 0xC0), which resolves to day 16, 15 days ahead, so it has not passed (interp A-0167), and 'ping'. It is stored and acknowledged as in that scenario (C-0658, C-0776, C-0778), stops cas.first_data (B-0215), and as ARQ traffic restarts sis.soft_link_idle (interp A-0320). The client on SAP 9 gets S_UNIDATA_INDICATION as there (A-0236). Since a client was bound, a DATA DELIVERY CONFIRM goes back to 0.0.1.3 (A-0237, A-0238, A-0170): TYPE 1, the DATA S_PDU's priority 0 (interp A-0175), source SAP 5 and destination SAP 9 unswapped (A-0174), and the whole U_PDU since sis.frag_size is unset (A-0172), 6 bytes, in a DATA C_PDU of 7. Interp A-0344: it goes by ARQ as the DATA S_PDU came, priority 0, no in-order delivery, TTD now plus the default TTL (61000 + 1296000000), marked as a client confirmation (B-0318), and it is outstanding on the soft link, so sis.soft_link_idle is cancelled again (interp A-0320) and the DTS starts dts.ttd for it with 1296000000 ms. At 83000 the transmission carries it in a DATA-ACK (type 11, EOT 20: FSN 0 from the initial TX UWE, C_PDU START and END, no DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN UWE and LWE, RX LWE 1 and no ack bytes) that also acknowledges the peer's FSN 0 (C-1128), then, in the fill of the second block, a copy of the acknowledgement as an ACK-ONLY (EOT 10, C-1154); 44 bytes, 2 blocks, so it ends at 93350 and dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. Fixture, addresses and draws as dts-arq/rx-data-acked: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms; seed 0 draws 15, 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080).
